messages:
Aisha (CSM): Quick sync — prepping account health packet for Nimbus renewal (Tue). Need final SLO figures (uptime %, p95 latency) and a projected credit calc if onboarding targets were missed. Also want a short enablement checklist for the customer lead. @Rajat @Lena
Rajat (CS Ops): Pulling the SLO dashboard for the last 90d now. Which billing window should I base the credit projection on? Contract references monthly SLOs by calendar month.
Lena (Solutions Eng): For enablement, there's playbook v2 (warmup + cache priming + traffic shaping). I can paste a minimal config snippet and a 15-min troubleshooting script. @Sam fyi — any infra caveats?
Sam (SRE): FYI we saw two short incidents in Jan that nudged the p95 up during heavy onboarding runs. I'm going to check prefix-cache metrics for this tenant to see cold-start impact.
Aisha (CSM): Thanks. Rajat — please run conservative and optimistic credit scenarios (monthly rolling baseline). Need: projected credit (USD), percent of invoice, and short rationale for each.
Rajat (CS Ops): Quick Q: include fallback-model costs (auto-routing) in the credit calc, or only primary-model token usage?
Molly (Acct Exec): Include primary-model only. Fallbacks are covered by our routing policy and not creditable per the T&C the customer signed.
Lena (Solutions Eng): Attaching the enablement snippet for runbook reference:
```yaml
cache:
  prefix_enabled: true
  ttl_seconds: 900
warmup:
  parallel_requests: 3
  tokens_threshold: 1024
request_routing:
  prefer_primary: true
```
Rajat (CS Ops): Posted numbers from the dashboard: p95 = 320ms (90d), uptime = 99.91%. SLA threshold = 99.95% monthly. Using that, conservative projection -> 1 monthly miss => credit = $2,100 (~3% of monthly invoice). Optimistic (apply partial month smoothing) -> $1,200. I'll include both in the packet.
Sam (SRE): Confirmed telemetry sources used by Rajat. Note: region failover event on 2025-01-15 produced a short latency spike — call that out as a known anomaly in the narrative.
Aisha (CSM): Perfect. Add a one-paragraph explanation (root cause, remediation, next steps) and a 3-line ops playbook for the customer admin. Also add an action list for the enablement session next Wed.
Lena (Solutions Eng): Will draft the 15-min troubleshooting script + slide with "what to try first" (cache primer, warmup endpoint, traffic shaping).
Rajat (CS Ops): I'll produce a small heatmap (risk by feature: KV cache, burst traffic, region failover) and a model-based credit table. Draft to you by EOD.
Molly (Acct Exec): Confirming renewal call is Tue 11am PT. We'll present the health packet and the proposed credit scenarios. @Aisha can you sign off slides by Mon 3pm?
Aisha (CSM): Affirmative — I'll review the draft. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: health-packet created -> https://redwood.internal/packets/nimbus-2025-01 (draft)
Rajat (CS Ops): Added action items: (1) finalize numbers, (2) attach enablement snippet, (3) annotate anomaly windows. Expect EOD delivery.
Aisha (CSM): Great — closing loop. If anything blocks, ping here.
_comment: This document is a Slack thread for customer-success channel about SLA/SLO alignment, onboarding, credits and enablement.
